why.shears: vanilla has no tag of shears alone: only the enchantable/* tags, shared with other items
why.shield: vanilla has no tag of shields alone: only the enchantable/* tags, shared with other items
why.bow: tag enchantable/bow exists from 1.20.6; 1.19.4 to 1.20.4 group no bow
why.crossbow: tag enchantable/crossbow exists from 1.20.6; 1.19.4 to 1.20.4 group no crossbow
why.ranged_weapon: the enchantable/bow, enchantable/crossbow and enchantable/trident tags define the family; 1.19.4 to 1.20.4 lack those tags
why.helmet: tag head_armor exists from 1.20.6; 1.19.4 to 1.20.4 group no armour piece
why.chestplate: tag chest_armor exists from 1.20.6; 1.19.4 to 1.20.4 group no armour piece
why.leggings: tag leg_armor exists from 1.20.6; 1.19.4 to 1.20.4 group no armour piece
why.boots: tag foot_armor exists from 1.20.6; 1.19.4 to 1.20.4 group no armour piece
why.head_gear: worn on the head but no armour: vanilla groups it in no tag of its own (enchantable/equippable also holds mob heads and every armour piece)
why.torso_gear: worn on the chest but no armour: vanilla groups it in no tag of its own (enchantable/equippable also holds mob heads and every armour piece)
why.boat: the 1.19.4 boats tag lacks the cherry and bamboo boats that the 1.19.4 registry already holds (parity test, 2026-11-06)
why.station: vanilla has no tag of crafting stations
why.falling_block: a full block that falls when unsupported: vanilla has no tag of them and minecraft-data has no gravity field (the other falling blocks are not full cubes)
why.avoided_food: the foods the hunger reflex never picks, each carrying an effect the model weighs for itself (this list is the only home of the choice: selectReflexFood, src/world/food.ts, skips the family); vanilla has no tag of them
why.container: vanilla has no block tag of storage containers (shulker boxes come from the shulker_boxes tag)
why.chest: vanilla has no block tag of chests: the chests whose lid an opaque block above stops (src/world/chest-clearance.ts)
why.projectile_entity: the blaze's small fireball and thrown trident are shield projectiles beside arrows; the entity tag impact_projectiles also holds snowballs and eggs; tridents use direction guarding, not unmeasured arrow flight physics
